groups.rule: CON-frame.5 allows an optional legacy velocity section after coordinates when 'sections' is absent, and CON-section.4 gives each component block a symbol line, a label and one row per atom, while CON-frame.7 opens the next frame if no section follows. Neither clause specifies how far a reader must probe past the blank line before committing to a velocity section: readcon probes only two lines ahead (a non-blank symbol line not starting with '{' followed by a line containing the consecutive words 'of' and 'component', src/parser.rs::section_follows) and commits to parsing a velocity block, whereas the independent reader checks all component headers and five-field velocity rows before committing (indep_reader.py::legacy_block).

groups.rule: CON-cell.6 derives the c lattice vector from (alpha, beta, gamma) by dividing by sin(gamma) and requires real lattice vectors without prescribing a binary64 zero tolerance on sin(gamma). For angles such as gamma = 900.0 degrees, sin(5*pi) is ~6.12e-16 in binary64 rather than exact 0.0: readcon rejects |sin(gamma)| < 1e-15 as an invalid cell (src/parser.rs::validate_cell_consistency), while the independent reader checks only sin(gamma) == 0.0 (indep_reader.py::cell_matrix).
groups.variant: the independent reader rejecting |sin(gamma)| < 1e-15 in CON-cell.6
